1.jpg.title: Mahalaya
1.jpg.caption: A nostalgic illustration inspired by the quiet anticipation of Mahalaya, capturing a peaceful early-morning moment accompanied by the familiar sound of the radio. The piece explores Bengali culture, atmosphere, and storytelling through warm lighting, traditional elements, and a cinematic 2D illustration style.

2.jpg.title: Little Krishna
2.jpg.caption: A narrative illustration series inspired by the playful childhood stories of Lord Krishna. The artwork explores character expression, traditional Indian costume, and visual storytelling through warm colours, textured backgrounds, and expressive 2D illustration.

4.jpg.caption: A detailed fantasy illustration depicting a witch brewing a glowing potion in her enchanted workspace. The piece focuses on atmospheric lighting, character design, magical details, and storytelling through environment and composition.

5.jpg.title: Alina
5.jpg.caption: A character design sheet created to explore Alina’s personality, fashion, and everyday interests through visual storytelling. The piece combines character illustration, expressive poses, personal belongings, and lifestyle details to build a cohesive and relatable character profile.

6.jpg.title: Sunflower Garden
6.jpg.caption: A romantic character illustration set in a vibrant sunflower field, capturing a quiet summer moment through expressive characters, natural surroundings, and a soft 2D illustration style.

Copy of BG copy.jpg.caption: This illustration captures a peaceful mountain valley framed by trees. The piece focuses on environment design, depth, natural textures, and atmospheric composition.

Copy of Coffee Date copy.jpg.title: Coffee Date
Copy of Coffee Date copy.jpg.caption: A cozy café moment capturing the quiet intimacy of two people sharing a warm drink and each other’s company. A personal illustration focused on character expression, atmosphere, and everyday romance.

Copy of Final.jpg.title: Human Portrait Study
Copy of Final.jpg.caption: A stylized portrait study exploring human features, expression, anatomy, and costume design. This piece was created as an exercise in capturing a more realistic human presence while maintaining my 2D illustration style.

Copy of Knight.jpg.title: Fallen Knight
Copy of Knight.jpg.caption: A dramatic fantasy illustration depicting a wounded knight resting in a field of wildflowers. The contrast between violence and the peaceful natural surroundings creates a quiet, melancholic atmosphere.

Copy of Text 1.jpg.title: The Red Thread Theory
Copy of Text 1.jpg.caption: A multi-panel visual narrative exploring the idea of destined connections and the invisible threads that bring two people together. Through everyday encounters, parallel moments, and sequential storytelling, the series follows a relationship shaped by coincidence, distance, and timing.
